notes.title: Updates: New patch, retrospective, and a big thank you
notes.notes:
Greetings Steam,

Some of you reported that the[b] game crashes on Windows 7 machines[/b]. Thanks to your feedback, [b]we've managed to identify the issue, test it, and fix it.[/b]

The game should be good to go! Thanks for your patience! Hope that you enjoy the game. Be sure to write the review, and join our Discord server to have an additional game discussion.

While we are at the subject at thanking - we would also like to say [b][i]big thanks to the press that supported us, and to our players[/i][/b]. Thank you for your kind words. Be sure to tell your friends about our game as every bit of visibility help.

Enjoy the new [u]1.1.0 version[/u], everyone!

Lightstep team

notes.title: FINAL DEMO OUT + sneak peek of the RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Steam,

Are you ready? We have [b]a lot of stuff to announce - new demo, sneak peek of the release date, AND Steam key giveaways![/b] Let's get to it.[/h1]

[h1]JUST PUBLISHED FINAL DEMO[/h1]

There's a new, final demo in the town. After you've played the last one and gave us your feedback, we've noticed areas which we could improve. So, this demo is the final representation of the game that we will publish on the store. Here: https://gamejolt.com/games/lightstepchronicles/400809.

We're so close to the end of the development! All the major things are complete. That's right! Optimization? Done. Texture polishing? Done. Sound effects and music?

All done! Sooo… [b]release date announcement coming next week[/b]. 

[h1]PREQUEL STORY AND DISCORD[/h1]

We have prepared you an [b]interesting prequel story[/b] that works as an introduction for the game. Is it necessary? No. Will it provide additional context to the game? Yes. The optional world-building is always fun in our book. It will prepare you for the upcoming journey and give you a little bit of material to discuss on Steam/Discord. We’ll publish it in the next few weeks so join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/P2qteu9. 

[h1]STEAM KEY GIVEAWAYS[/h1]

Also, be sure to join our [b]Lightstep Discord server[/b] as we plan to make steam key giveaways in our prerelease campaign! That's right - there's a chance to be an active part of the community and get prizes according to that! Also, you'll be able to talk to the developers, discuss popular AIs, and many other off topics with fellow sci-fi fans.

----> [url=https://discord.gg/P2qteu9]DISCORD [/url]<---- 

'Till next time!


Gameplay trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=REGHXe_eJVM
Discord: https://discord.gg/P2qteu9
Twitter: https://twitter.com/colony_66
Demo: https://gamejolt.com/games/lightstepchronicles/400809

notes.title: PUBLIC DEMO REMINDER + Dev update | May 20, 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33972272/0762c246177c6800a84b544d0b9f058649122273.gif[/img]

Hello Steam,

It’s been a while since you last hear from us and the reason is mostly because our work is now - bugs and fixes. We are now aware too - that is how the final process looks like. During what we thought was our final playthrough of Lightstep Chronicles, we came upon some lackluster moments that wouldn't do for a game of this size. So, beside bugs and fixes, we are back at polishing and touching up the lighting, some animations, and the sound effects. Here is what we did (and still doing) since our last update:

[list]
[*] Sound effect and music polish
[*] Postprocess optimization
[*] Lightning rebaking for several locations
[*] Texture polishing
[*] Animation improvement in final scenes
[/list]

[h1]Also, we wanted to highlight here that we have a[b] public dem[/b]o - for all of you new to our game and updates. The free demo includes the first chapter of the game and it’s available for download at [url=https://eipix.itch.io/lightstep-chronicles]Itch page[/url] and a [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/lightstepchronicles/400809]Game Jolt page[/url].[/h1]

We believe you will have loads to tell us after playing the demo so we are looking forward to hearing from you - whether here in discussion tab or at our [url=https://discord.gg/P2qteu9]Discord server[/url].  

‘Til next time,
LSC team
